chapter: London and return to New York
title: Band personnel after returning from London
summary: The interviewer asks who was in the band; La Rocca names Robertson on piano, Shields, Sbarbaro, Edwards and saxophonist Benny Kruger, who was versatile but not a jazz man.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I hate to interrupt you on that story but I missed out a couple of things. I didn't get who was in the band at the time. I know Edwards was back. He replaced Christian and I didn't get the names of the other bands.

Now I'll tell you the names of the men. Robertson joined us as piano player which he had been the first steady piano player after Regis' death. We had Shields, myself, Spobara, Edwards and what's his name? Roberts had made the five of us.
And that's immediately upon coming back from London. That's right. Robertson Hilton. And then what was the name of the saxophone players? I want to get that to you.
It was Benny Kruger. Benny Kruger. One of the most versatile men in New York at the time. Yes sir. But he was not a jazz man.
